instruction: Launch GitKraken from Activities and initialize a new repository at ~/Documents/gk_task_init; create README.md with the text "GitKraken Task 1", stage it, and make an initial commit titled "init commit".

verification.condition: Verify that ~/Documents/gk_task_init/.git exists, ~/Documents/gk_task_init/README.md contains the string "GitKraken Task 1", and git -C ~/Documents/gk_task_init rev-list --count HEAD equals 1.
verification.expected_result: A Git repository exists at ~/Documents/gk_task_init with exactly one commit that includes README.md containing "GitKraken Task 1".
